_schema.doc: Template. Put your own file at --changes PATH or <out-root>/changes.json (default ~/Documents/claude-usage/changes.json). Each entry compares the metrics in the 14 days before and after its date.
_schema.date: YYYY-MM-DD: the day the change took effect (local time)
_schema.description: short text, for example 'subagent cache TTL set to 1h'
_schema.metrics: list, any of: sessions, calls, input_uncached, cache_write_5m, cache_write_1h, cache_read, output, cache_hit_pct, write_share_pct, median_peak_context, max_peak_context, median_first_call_context, tokens_per_session, cost_weighted_input_usd, compactions, auto_compactions, limit_hits
